title: Pulihora
steps: Cool the cooked rice completely and separate the grains.
Temper mustard seeds, peanuts and curry leaves in sesame oil.
Add tamarind pulp and turmeric; simmer until it thickens.
Fold the tempering through the rice and rest for ten minutes.
ritualNotes: No onion or garlic in naivedyam.
Offer to the deity before anyone tastes it.
Use a clean vessel kept for puja use only.
